hypothesis: Five explicitly defined classic harmonic patterns and a second causal ZigZag level may produce more tradable reversal entries than the previous Gartley/Bat single-level proxy. Preserve the previous detect entry and time20 exit to isolate recognition breadth.

research_provenance.implementation: mechanical adaptation, not historical UltimateX alerts
research_provenance.deviation: Only five of eight author-listed classic families have a directly comparable XABCD geometry here; private ratio table and recursive engine unavailable.

required_data: confirmed level-0 and derived level-1 pivot events
availability_lag: Level 0 uses wing completed bars after pivot center; level 1 confirms after two subsequent level-0 events, each already confirmed on source bars. Entry signal at confirmation close; fill next open.
signal_semantics: Bullish and bearish XABCD reversal events per stock. Level 1 is computed from the causal stream of confirmed level-0 pivots and never backdated to the plotted pivot center.
evaluation_unit: Independent experimental account per stock; one global variant selected by early history for any paper review.

mechanisms: detect on confirmed D pivot, fixed from parent experiment
entry_design.confirmation: 8% tolerance on declared ratio ranges; base ZigZag wing 5 or 8 and 2% reversal; level 1 uses wing 2 on confirmed level-0 event stream; reject candidates whose stop or 61.8% AD target was touched after D center before confirmation.
not_applicable: retrace30 is held out because this experiment isolates recognition breadth

mechanisms: fixed parent time20: exit on invalidation or 20 bars after fill, next open
exit_design.extension_stop: D minus or plus 10% of absolute AD, by direction
exit_design.target: 61.8% AD used only to reject already completed pre-entry patterns; no profit target in time20 rule
not_applicable: new trailing or multiple targets in this recognition experiment

parameter_rationale: Base wings 5 and 8 reproduce prior controls; level 1 is an explicit coarser event-derived scale. Five classic families have stated XABCD ratio definitions. A union tests their combined signal flow. No return-driven parameter search.

pattern_exclusions.cypher: C extends above A and D references XC; needs separate geometry and stop rules
pattern_exclusions.shark: O-X-A-B-C structure, not a direct XABCD rule
pattern_exclusions.nenstar: Author private ratio definition not verified from accessible primary material

baseline: One 25% long buy-and-hold position on same stock/timeframe, filled next open.
signal_rule: For each declared XABCD family and causal level, signal at confirmed D if no intervening stop/target. Union picks one per pivot tuple in priority Gartley, Bat, Butterfly, Crab, DeepCrab. Exit at stop or 20 completed bars. All fills next open.
execution_timing: Completed-bar decision; next-open execution; 25% equity per separate stock account.
holding_period: At most 20 completed signal bars after entry.
cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
selection: Review all 48 timeframe x rule settings by early ranking; select first with every liquid stock above policy trailing-12m threshold, inspect >20% separately. Late history is seen, not an independent holdout.
limitations: Not exact UltimateX source or alert stream
Extension stop is an explicit proxy
Late history already viewed; no independent backtest
Corporate actions and short borrow incomplete
